'''Rod Latham Imperial Security Bureau''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds47.htm Imperial Security Bureau], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010119092100/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds47.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
